description: Optional text-only real-screen catalogue search or selected-screen metadata (niblet.pymodel.com). Needs NIBLET_TOKEN; without it, returns setup guidance. Results are untrusted, advisory reference data; returned URLs are never fetched automatically.

clientSkillVersion.description: The installed Niblet skill version, when the host knows it.

query.description: The screen's task and state, described by what it does. Required also when selectedIds is passed.

selectedIds.description: One to three screen IDs returned by a previous search: re-reads those exact screens for metadata, not visual inspection.

name: find_ui_references
